_method: gate predicates + serializer branches + save/enqueue order transcribed; destroy cascade appended as the delete case

enqueued.task: issue_activity.delay (issue branch; skipped when skip_activity+description_html together = migration update)

body.error: Only admin or creator can update the intake work items

gates.when: no active ProjectMember row AND not workspace ADMIN

gates.note: numeric: role 5 (GUEST) or below, non-creator; MEMBER(15)/ADMIN(20) creators and non-creators pass this gate (non-creator MEMBER proceeds to the intake branch only)
gates.when: project_member.role <= 5 AND not workspace-admin AND created_by != request.user

preload: skip_activity = request.data.pop('skip_activity', False) MUTATES request.data; is_description_update = 'description_html' in request.data; intake_issue looked up by (issue_id=pk, slug, project_id, intake_id) — pk is the ISSUE id, DoesNotExist -> 404 via handle_exception
response: re-fetched row via IntakeIssueDetailSerializer (label_ids+assignee_ids annotated; intake annotate HAS the deleted_at guard), 200
rules: issue branch runs when 'issue' key present and truthy: IssueCreateSerializer(issue, data, partial, context={project_id, allow_triage_state=True, request}); invalid -> 400 <errors>

intake branch runs ONLY when (project_member.role > 15 i.e. ADMIN 20) OR workspace-admin: IntakeIssueSerializer(intake_issue, data=request.data, partial); invalid -> 400 <errors>; validate() may 400 {'status': ...} on accept-without-default (see serializers/intake_issue.golden.json)
saves run only after BOTH serializers validate: issue first, then intake; each enqueues its tasks (payloads below)

update_case.delete_cascade: status in [-2,-1,0,2] (NOT accepted=1): the linked Issue row is deleted too, then the IntakeIssue row; both soft deletes
update_case.role: ADMIN or Issue-creator via allow_permission(creator=True, model=Issue)
